text: {"score":3,"justification":"The headline numbers match the card and the wording is cautious. The 99215 claims cited for low complexity (C0043035, C0043172, C0043459) are real and fit that point. The multi-morbid examples (C0043166, C0043477) are also real. However, several claims in the narrative are wrong or unsupported, and the next steps do not follow from the narrative. An investigator would have to redo some of the analysis.","problems":["The summary says the elevated 99215 share holds across every complexity tier, but the card shows 99215 shares that are all far above the all-provider shares. This holds, yet the summary does not give tier numbers.","The text says it is concerning, then 'too thin to lean either way'. The 'leaning inconclusive' stance is internally awkward.","The phrase 'three of ten documented 99214s ... an unsupported rate well above peers' rests on tiny numbers (3 of 10, and 1 of 1 for 99215). It is presented as hinting at a broader leveling pattern, which overreaches.","The summary says the comparison rate for below-billed 99215 is 14%, but the 'all_provider_rate' of 0.143 is a rate for all providers, not necessarily the comparison providers. The summary also mentions only 1 documented 99215, so the 100% figure is statistically meaningless and is not flagged as such.","The narrative says 'rash and back-pain visits', but no rash diagnosis appears in the low-complexity 99215 sample; the diagnoses are R21 (rash), M54.50, J06.9, R10.9. R21 is rash, so this is fine, but the narrative does not mention abdominal pain.","The next steps are generic and do not follow the narrative's own advice. The narrative says to request charts for the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims, but the next_steps instead say to request a larger sample of 99214 and 99215 claims and to re-screen. Neither names specific claim IDs.","The summary does not flag that no documented 99215 supports the billed level, or that the low documentation rate (2.9%) limits the findings.","Cited examples C0043035 and C0043037 are sound, but the summary does not use C0043501 (99214, low MDM, minutes not recorded) as an example despite mentioning it."]}
